summary: Find standalone roles via Roles > Roles on Galaxy, or from the CLI with ansible-galaxy role search, filtering by tags, platforms and author; up to 1000 results are returned.
questions: How do I search Galaxy roles from the command line?
How do I find roles by a specific author?
How many results does ansible-galaxy role search return?

answer_card.title: Search for roles on Galaxy
answer_card.answer_md:
In the web UI use **Roles > Roles**. From the CLI:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role search elasticsearch --author geerlingguy
```
You can filter by tags, platforms, author and keywords; up to the first 1000 matches are returned.
